paragraphs.text: And when he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
paragraphs.original: Καταβάντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοί.
paragraphs.translit: Katabantos de autou apo tou orous ēkolouthēsan autō ochloi polloi.

paragraphs.text: And behold, there came to him a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ λεπρὸς προσελθὼν προσεκύνει αὐτῷ λέγων· Κύριε, ἐὰν θέλῃς δύνασαί με καθαρίσαι.
paragraphs.translit: kai idou lepros proselthōn prosekynei autō legōn· Kyrie, ean thelēs dynasai me katharisai.

paragraphs.text: And he stretched forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou made clean. And straightway his leprosy was cleansed.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα ἥψατο αὐτοῦ λέγων· Θέλω, καθαρίσθητι· καὶ εὐθέως ἐκαθαρίσθη αὐτοῦ ἡ λέπρα.
paragraphs.translit: kai ekteinas tēn cheira hēpsato autou legōn· Thelō, katharisthēti· kai eutheōs ekatharisthē autou hē lepra.

paragraphs.text: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go, show thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
paragraphs.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ὅρα μηδενὶ εἴπῃς, ἀλλὰ ὕπαγε σεαυτὸν δεῖξον τῷ ἱερεῖ, καὶ προσένεγκον τὸ δῶρον ὃ προσέταξεν Μωϋσῆς εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς.
paragraphs.translit: kai legei autō ho Iēsous· Hora mēdeni eipēs, alla hypage seauton deixon tō hierei, kai prosenenkon to dōron ho prosetaxen Mōysēs eis martyrion autois.

paragraphs.text: And when he was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
paragraphs.original: Εἰσελθόντος δὲ αὐτοῦ εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ προσῆλθεν αὐτῷ ἑκατόνταρχος παρακαλῶν αὐτὸν
paragraphs.translit: Eiselthontos de autou eis Kapharnaoum prosēlthen autō hekatontarchos parakalōn auton

paragraphs.text: and saying, Lord, my servant lieth in the house sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
paragraphs.original: καὶ λέγων· Κύριε, ὁ παῖς μου βέβληται ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ παραλυτικός, δεινῶς βασανιζόμενος.
paragraphs.translit: kai legōn· Kyrie, ho pais mou beblētai en tē oikia paralytikos, deinōs basanizomenos.

paragraphs.text: And he saith unto him, I will come and heal him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ· Ἐγὼ ἐλθὼν θεραπεύσω αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: kai legei autō· Egō elthōn therapeusō auton.

paragraphs.text: And the centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof; but only say the word, and my servant shall be healed.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ ἑκατόνταρχος ἔφη· Κύριε, οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς ἵνα μου ὑπὸ τὴν στέγην εἰσέλθῃς· ἀλλὰ μόνον εἰπὲ λόγῳ, καὶ ἰαθήσεται ὁ παῖς μου·
paragraphs.translit: kai apokritheis ho hekatontarchos ephē· Kyrie, ouk eimi hikanos hina mou hypo tēn stegēn eiselthēs· alla monon eipe logō, kai iathēsetai ho pais mou·

paragraphs.text: For I also am a man under authority, having under myself soldiers: and I say to this one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
paragraphs.original: καὶ γὰρ ἐγὼ ἄνθρωπός εἰμι ὑπὸ ἐξουσίαν, ἔχων ὑπʼ ἐμαυτὸν στρατιώτας, καὶ λέγω τούτῳ· Πορεύθητι, καὶ πορεύεται, καὶ ἄλλῳ· Ἔρχου, καὶ ἔρχεται, καὶ τῷ δούλῳ μου· Ποίησον τοῦτο, καὶ ποιεῖ.
paragraphs.translit: kai gar egō anthrōpos eimi hypo exousian, echōn hypʼ emauton stratiōtas, kai legō toutō· Poreuthēti, kai poreuetai, kai allō· Erchou, kai erchetai, kai tō doulō mou· Poiēson touto, kai poiei.

paragraphs.text: And when Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
paragraphs.original: ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐθαύμασεν καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς ἀκολουθοῦσιν· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, παρʼ οὐδενὶ τοσαύτην πίστιν ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ εὗρον.
paragraphs.translit: akousas de ho Iēsous ethaumasen kai eipen tois akolouthousin· Amēn legō hymin, parʼ oudeni tosautēn pistin en tō Israēl heuron.

paragraphs.text: And I say unto you, that many shall come from the east and the west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven:
paragraphs.original: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι πολλοὶ ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν καὶ δυσμῶν ἥξουσιν καὶ ἀνακλιθήσονται μετὰ Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακὼβ ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν·
paragraphs.translit: legō de hymin hoti polloi apo anatolōn kai dysmōn hēxousin kai anaklithēsontai meta Abraam kai Isaak kai Iakōb en tē basileia tōn ouranōn·

paragraphs.text: but the sons of the kingdom shall be cast forth into the outer darkness: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
paragraphs.original: οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ τῆς βασιλείας ἐκβληθήσονται εἰς τὸ σκότος τὸ ἐξώτερον· ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων.
paragraphs.translit: hoi de hyioi tēs basileias ekblēthēsontai eis to skotos to exōteron· ekei estai ho klauthmos kai ho brygmos tōn odontōn.

paragraphs.text: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; as thou hast believed, [so] be it done unto thee. And the servant was healed in that hour.
paragraphs.original: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῷ ἑκατοντάρχῃ· Ὕπαγε, ὡς ἐπίστευσας γενηθήτω σοι· καὶ ἰάθη ὁ παῖς ἐν τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐκείνῃ.
paragraphs.translit: kai eipen ho Iēsous tō hekatontarchē· Hypage, hōs episteusas genēthētō soi· kai iathē ho pais en tē hōra ekeinē.

paragraphs.text: And when Jesus was come into Peter`s house, he saw his wife`s mother lying sick of a fever.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἐλθὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Πέτρου εἶδεν τὴν πενθερὰν αὐτοῦ βεβλημένην καὶ πυρέσσουσαν·
paragraphs.translit: Kai elthōn ho Iēsous eis tēn oikian Petrou eiden tēn pentheran autou beblēmenēn kai pyressousan·

paragraphs.text: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her; and she arose, and ministered unto him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἥψατο τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῆς, καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτὴν ὁ πυρετός, καὶ ἠγέρθη καὶ διηκόνει αὐτῷ.
paragraphs.translit: kai hēpsato tēs cheiros autēs, kai aphēken autēn ho pyretos, kai ēgerthē kai diēkonei autō.

paragraphs.text: And when even was come, they brought unto him many possessed with demons: and he cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all that were sick:
paragraphs.original: Ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ δαιμονιζομένους πολλούς· καὶ ἐξέβαλεν τὰ πνεύματα λόγῳ, καὶ πάντας τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας ἐθεράπευσεν·
paragraphs.translit: Opsias de genomenēs prosēnenkan autō daimonizomenous pollous· kai exebalen ta pneumata logō, kai pantas tous kakōs echontas etherapeusen·

paragraphs.text: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying: Himself took our infirmities, and bare our diseases.
paragraphs.original: ὅπως πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος· Αὐτὸς τὰς ἀσθενείας ἡμῶν ἔλαβεν καὶ τὰς νόσους ἐβάστασεν.
paragraphs.translit: hopōs plērōthē to rhēthen dia Ēsaiou tou prophētou legontos· Autos tas astheneias hēmōn elaben kai tas nosous ebastasen.

paragraphs.text: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandments to depart unto the other side.
paragraphs.original: Ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς πολλοὺς ὄχλους περὶ αὐτὸν ἐκέλευσεν ἀπελθεῖν εἰς τὸ πέραν.
paragraphs.translit: Idōn de ho Iēsous pollous ochlous peri auton ekeleusen apelthein eis to peran.

paragraphs.text: And there came a scribe, and said unto him, Teacher, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
paragraphs.original: καὶ προσελθὼν εἷς γραμματεὺς εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Διδάσκαλε, ἀκολουθήσω σοι ὅπου ἐὰν ἀπέρχῃ.
paragraphs.translit: kai proselthōn heis grammateus eipen autō· Didaskale, akolouthēsō soi hopou ean aperchē.

paragraphs.text: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the heaven [have] nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
paragraphs.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Αἱ ἀλώπεκες φωλεοὺς ἔχουσιν καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατασκηνώσεις, ὁ δὲ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου οὐκ ἔχει ποῦ τὴν κεφαλὴν κλίνῃ.
paragraphs.translit: kai legei autō ho Iēsous· Hai alōpekes phōleous echousin kai ta peteina tou ouranou kataskēnōseis, ho de hyios tou anthrōpou ouk echei pou tēn kephalēn klinē.

paragraphs.text: And another of the disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
paragraphs.original: ἕτερος δὲ τῶν μαθητῶν εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Κύριε, ἐπίτρεψόν μοι πρῶτον ἀπελθεῖν καὶ θάψαι τὸν πατέρα μου.
paragraphs.translit: heteros de tōn mathētōn eipen autō· Kyrie, epitrepson moi prōton apelthein kai thapsai ton patera mou.

paragraphs.text: But Jesus saith unto him, Follow me; and leave the dead to bury their own dead.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτῷ· Ἀκολούθει μοι, καὶ ἄφες τοὺς νεκροὺς θάψαι τοὺς ἑαυτῶν νεκρούς.
paragraphs.translit: ho de Iēsous legei autō· Akolouthei moi, kai aphes tous nekrous thapsai tous heautōn nekrous.

paragraphs.text: And when he was entered into a boat, his disciples followed him.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἐμβάντι αὐτῷ εἰς πλοῖον ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Kai embanti autō eis ploion ēkolouthēsan autō hoi mathētai autou.

paragraphs.text: And behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the boat was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ σεισμὸς μέγας ἐγένετο ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ, ὥστε τὸ πλοῖον καλύπτεσθαι ὑπὸ τῶν κυμάτων, αὐτὸς δὲ ἐκάθευδεν.
paragraphs.translit: kai idou seismos megas egeneto en tē thalassē, hōste to ploion kalyptesthai hypo tōn kymatōn, autos de ekatheuden.

paragraphs.text: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Save, Lord; we perish.
paragraphs.original: καὶ προσελθόντες ἤγειραν αὐτὸν λέγοντες· Κύριε, σῶσον, ἀπολλύμεθα.
paragraphs.translit: kai proselthontes ēgeiran auton legontes· Kyrie, sōson, apollymetha.

paragraphs.text: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
paragraphs.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Τί δειλοί ἐστε, ὀλιγόπιστοι; τότε ἐγερθεὶς ἐπετίμησεν τοῖς ἀνέμοις καὶ τῇ θαλάσσῃ, καὶ ἐγένετο γαλήνη μεγάλη.
paragraphs.translit: kai legei autois· Ti deiloi este, oligopistoi; tote egertheis epetimēsen tois anemois kai tē thalassē, kai egeneto galēnē megalē.

paragraphs.text: And the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him?
paragraphs.original: οἱ δὲ ἄνθρωποι ἐθαύμασαν λέγοντες· Ποταπός ἐστιν οὗτος ὅτι καὶ οἱ ἄνεμοι καὶ ἡ θάλασσα αὐτῷ ὑπακούουσιν;
paragraphs.translit: hoi de anthrōpoi ethaumasan legontes· Potapos estin houtos hoti kai hoi anemoi kai hē thalassa autō hypakouousin;

paragraphs.text: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gadarenes, there met him two possessed with demons, coming forth out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man could pass by that way.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἐλθόντος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ πέραν εἰς τὴν χώραν τῶν Γαδαρηνῶν ὑπήντησαν αὐτῷ δύο δαιμονιζόμενοι ἐκ τῶν μνημείων ἐξερχόμενοι, χαλεποὶ λίαν ὥστε μὴ ἰσχύειν τινὰ παρελθεῖν διὰ τῆς ὁδοῦ ἐκείνης.
paragraphs.translit: Kai elthontos autou eis to peran eis tēn chōran tōn Gadarēnōn hypēntēsan autō dyo daimonizomenoi ek tōn mnēmeiōn exerchomenoi, chalepoi lian hōste mē ischyein tina parelthein dia tēs hodou ekeinēs.

paragraphs.text: And behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔκραξαν λέγοντες· Τί ἡμῖν καὶ σοί, υἱὲ τοῦ θεοῦ; ἦλθες ὧδε πρὸ καιροῦ βασανίσαι ἡμᾶς;
paragraphs.translit: kai idou ekraxan legontes· Ti hēmin kai soi, hyie tou theou; ēlthes hōde pro kairou basanisai hēmas;

paragraphs.text: Now there was afar off from them a herd of many swine feeding.
paragraphs.original: ἦν δὲ μακρὰν ἀπʼ αὐτῶν ἀγέλη χοίρων πολλῶν βοσκομένη.
paragraphs.translit: ēn de makran apʼ autōn agelē choirōn pollōn boskomenē.

paragraphs.text: And the demons besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, send us away into the herd of swine.
paragraphs.original: οἱ δὲ δαίμονες παρεκάλουν αὐτὸν λέγοντες· Εἰ ἐκβάλλεις ἡμᾶς, ἀπόστειλον ἡμᾶς εἰς τὴν ἀγέλην τῶν χοίρων.
paragraphs.translit: hoi de daimones parekaloun auton legontes· Ei ekballeis hēmas, aposteilon hēmas eis tēn agelēn tōn choirōn.

paragraphs.text: And he said unto them, Go. And they came out, and went into the swine: and behold, the whole herd rushed down the steep into the sea, and perished in the waters.
paragraphs.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ὑπάγετε. οἱ δὲ ἐξελθόντες ἀπῆλθον εἰς τοὺς χοίρους· καὶ ἰδοὺ ὥρμησεν πᾶσα ἡ ἀγέλη κατὰ τοῦ κρημνοῦ εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν, καὶ ἀπέθανον ἐν τοῖς ὕδασιν.
paragraphs.translit: kai eipen autois· Hypagete. hoi de exelthontes apēlthon eis tous choirous· kai idou hōrmēsen pasa hē agelē kata tou krēmnou eis tēn thalassan, kai apethanon en tois hydasin.

paragraphs.text: And they that fed them fled, and went away into the city, and told everything, and what was befallen to them that were possessed with demons.
paragraphs.original: οἱ δὲ βόσκοντες ἔφυγον, καὶ ἀπελθόντες εἰς τὴν πόλιν ἀπήγγειλαν πάντα καὶ τὰ τῶν δαιμονιζομένων.
paragraphs.translit: hoi de boskontes ephygon, kai apelthontes eis tēn polin apēngeilan panta kai ta tōn daimonizomenōn.

paragraphs.text: And behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought [him] that he would depart from their borders.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ πᾶσα ἡ πόλις ἐξῆλθεν εἰς ὑπάντησιν τῷ Ἰησοῦ, καὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν παρεκάλεσαν ὅπως μεταβῇ ἀπὸ τῶν ὁρίων αὐτῶν.
paragraphs.translit: kai idou pasa hē polis exēlthen eis hypantēsin tō Iēsou, kai idontes auton parekalesan hopōs metabē apo tōn horiōn autōn.
